messages:
jordan: heads-up — a customer hit a weird case when exporting audit logs from the console. they triggered an org-level export from Account-B which is a delegated operator for Account-A, and lots of actor columns came back empty in the CSV.

jordan: here's the header and one row they shared (sanitized):
```
event_ts,event_type,actor_id,actor_email,actor_scope,resource_id,action,details
2026-03-15T21:03:12Z,policy.update,, ,delegated,proj-123,update,policy changed
```

maria: hmm. actor_scope shows delegated but actor_id/email are blank? that suggests we masked the actor because the service principal that performed the request doesn't have permission to view decrypted actor metadata (KMS) OR we intentionally collapse delegated actors to avoid leaking cross-account identities. do we have a preflight check for export permissions anywhere?

alex: we do a basic RBAC check for "audit.export" on the requesting principal, but we don't check whether that principal is allowed to reveal identities from the delegated account. effectively: export allowed -> stream proceeds; identity resolution pulls from KMS but fails -> empties fields.

tess: this matches the customer's error: the export succeeded but columns were empty. they expected an error like "export not allowed for delegated actors" or a clear warning. UX should not produce a partially empty CSV.

maria: proposal: two things: 1) add a preflight endpoint that validates both export perms and cross-account reveal permission (return 200 + warnings or 403 with reason), 2) add a schema field `actor_disclosure` with values ["full", "masked", "redacted-delegated"] so downstream consumers can detect why fields are empty.

jordan: +1 to both. customers parse CSVs programmatically — they need machine readable reason, not just a console banner.

alex: tech notes: KMS unwrap happens per-actor.metadata and requires kms:Decrypt for the kms_key_id associated with Account-A. delegated operator typically does not have that. options:
- attempt to fetch and include `kms_key_id` column (but do NOT include plaintext) so admins can see why it failed;
- or include `actor_disclosure` enum and a `disclosure_reason` string (e.g., "kms:Decrypt denied", "cross-account-policy").

sec-bot: Reminder: exposing kms_key_id may be PII/IPC sensitive; flagged by policy-high. please run privacy review if we add key IDs to customer-visible exports. :warning:

tess: From UI side: if preflight returns warnings or failure, we should disable the CSV/JSON export button and show an inline modal explaining: "Export will redact actor identities due to delegation; run delegated export with Account-A credentials or request disclosure role." Also allow an "Include redacted metadata" toggle so user intentionally accepts partial export.

maria: API spec sketch:
POST /api/v1/audit_exports/preflight
body: {"scope":"org|project|account","target_account":"acct-A","include_full_actor":true}
response 200: {"ok":true,"actor_disclosure":"masked","disclosure_reason":"kms:Decrypt denied","warnings":["will redact cross-account actor ids"]}
response 403: {"ok":false,"error":"delegation_mismatch","message":"requesting principal lacks audit:reveal on target account"}

alex: implementation caveat: current export path streams events from the event-store with cursor-based pagination. if we decide to surface `disclosure_reason` per-row (it can vary by event/actor), we need to either: a) pre-compute disclosure state per-event before streaming (adds latency and reads), or b) insert a column with default global export-level disclosure and set per-row to empty (less accurate). i prefer (a) for correctness.

jordan: agreed — correctness trumps perf here. we can do an optimized pass that only checks actors present in the export set (dedupe actor ids then call KMS policy check). keeps cost down.

tess: UX followups: i'll wire the modal and toggle. when preflight shows mixed row-level reasons, show a short summary: "Some rows will redact actor ids (n events). See export manifest for details." and include link to export manifest JSON that lists per-row disclosure reasons.

maria: action items:
- maria: open API PR for preflight + new `actor_disclosure` enum and `disclosure_reason` (ETA Tue)
- tess: add UI disable / modal / toggle + manifest link (ETA Wed)
- alex: implement server-side precompute + include `disclosure_reason` in export manifest, keep CSV header safe (no plaintext KMS unwrapped data) (ETA Thu)
- jordan: coordinate with customer and privacy for messaging and sample manifest (ETA Fri)

jordan: one more: telemetry. add event `audit_export_preflight.checked` with fields: request_principal, target_account, result.{ok|warn|denied}, disclosure_summary. alex can add.

alex: noted, will add telemetry and an opt-out flag for customers who don't want preflight logged.

maria: ok i'll start drafting the spec and ping @sec-bot for privacy review once PR is up.

jordan: thanks team. this should address the "mystery empty actor columns" and give customers deterministic behavior. :thumbsup:
